gui.cause: The harness cached GetDlgItem(window,113) before its readiness wait. Early discovery returned null; the later predicate proved the control existed but the cached null remained. WM_GETTEXTLENGTH then failed with ERROR_INVALID_WINDOW_HANDLE. This is a source-confirmed harness binding bug.
gui.fix: Acquire and validate the status HWND after the visibility/control readiness predicate succeeds. Preserve message diagnostics, process observation, all deadlines and explicit clean exit.
